audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer had her ability slots scrambled: 'Hounds' Pursuit (E)' (really R; E is Eviscerate) and 'Call of the Pack (R)' credited with a shield (Call of the Pack is W — untargetable + MS/AD/extra packmates; the shield is on Hounds' Pursuit's recast). Plus 19 misgendered fields and a cooldowns field with no number.
audit.why: Riot kit: Q Darkin Daggers 9-7s, W The Call of the Pack 26-18s untargetable, E Eviscerate 11-7s dash, R Hounds' Pursuit 110/95/80s lock-on dash with recast shield.
audit.corrected: Slot names fixed in spikes[0], spikes[1], whys[4], mid and wants.foe[1]; pronouns fixed; cooldowns now carry 110/95/80 and 11s.

edits.before: - Naafiri Hounds’ Pursuit: matchup-defining — The lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W gold card for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
